notes: The big one: full FL-parity update. Mixer routing with sends, submixes and 25 FX slots; Piano Roll depth (16 note colours, chord + riff tools, ghost notes, scripting); 44 built-in effects and 15 instruments including Cali Preset Synth, Multisampler with SF2 import, Pad Sampler, Analog, Acid Bass and Speech Synth; VST2 hosting alongside VST3/AU/CLAP; Cali AI assistant (your own OpenRouter key, approval-first actions), stem separation and AI mastering; track freeze, Cali Time Warp, audio-to-score, autosave with backups, project macros, 2X Remote phone control; bigger sound library, FLAC/OGG export, stem and bundle exports.
